title: Medical Device Alarm Management Transfer: Applying IEC 62133 Alarm Prioritization to AI Monitor Alerts

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Alert fatigue is a documented safety problem. Importing proven alarm management solutions from medical devices is faster than rediscovering them. Direct practical impact on human-in-the-loop monitoring quality.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: The alarm management layer is straightforward software engineering. However, the user study component adds significant complexity (recruitment, design, analysis). Without the user study, the project is incomplete; with it, it may exceed beginner capability.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Reviewing standards, designing an alarm management layer, implementing it, AND running a user study is four distinct work packages. The user study alone could consume 30 hours. Needs to drop the user study or the implementation.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
